mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate serves as a direct proxy for monetary policy tightness; higher rates compress equity valuations through increased discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.7%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive returns are not significantly higher than the baseline when both series are rising (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the signal (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns are not significantly different from the baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (the 2017 index base) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of retail sales serves as a direct proxy for consumer spending strength; higher retail sales indicate strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Retail Sales and Equity Market Performance
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 100000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in the federal funds rate and inflation above their 12-month averages signals that the Fed is responding to inflation with rate hikes, but the market perceives this as economic resilience, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary Policy Tapering and Equity Returns
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive returns are not significantly higher than the baseline when both series are above their 12-month averages (t-test p>0.05).
